name: Siding
summary: Siding repair and replacement, soffit, fascia, exterior trim, sealing and storm-damage restoration for residential and commercial properties across Dallas–Fort Worth.
features: Storm, hail and wind damage restoration
Rotten wood and moisture-damaged material replacement
Coordination with roofing and exterior repairs

faqs.question: When should damaged siding be replaced instead of repaired?
faqs.answer: Replacement may be recommended when damage is widespread, materials are deteriorated, moisture has reached the sheathing or matching repairs would not provide a durable and consistent result.

faqs.question: Can siding damage lead to water intrusion?
faqs.answer: Yes. Open joints, cracks, missing panels, failed caulking and damaged trim can allow moisture behind the exterior finish and should be evaluated promptly.

faqs.question: Can you repair soffit, fascia and exterior trim with the siding project?
faqs.answer: Yes. Related exterior components can be inspected and included in the same repair scope when they are damaged, deteriorated or contributing to water entry.

faqs.question: Do siding repairs include painting and sealing?
faqs.answer: When included in the scope, repaired or replaced areas can be caulked, primed, painted and sealed so the exterior has a finished and weather-resistant result.
